BiblicalUsage: Hazar-susim, the village of horses, is named among the Simeonite cities held until the reign of David. The list places it beside Beth-marcaboth and Beth-birei, towns of the same southern country.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the towns of the small tribes too. Hazar-susim belonged to Simeon, and Simeon's cities are named in full.
